app: Watchpost: managed threat detection and response for small businesses (built on Wazuh)

personas.role: Owner of a 40-person dental group (3 offices)
personas.cares_about: Keeping the practice open, protecting patient data, passing the cyber-insurance renewal, not ending up in the news.
personas.time_spent: Running the business; looks at security only when an email or invoice forces it.
personas.struggles: Security reports are full of jargon; can't tell whether they're actually protected.
personas.how_helps: Overview says in one sentence whether they're protected and what, if anything, the team must do, with plain-English labels, insurance and HIPAA status, and one dated monthly report.

tasks.name: See own company status, open tasks and the monthly summary (no MSP data)
Own plan price is shown, partner pricing is not

personas.role: Office manager who is the 'accidental IT person'
personas.cares_about: Staff can work, no downtime, knowing what to do when something happens.
personas.time_spent: Scheduling, vendors, front desk, fixing printers and passwords.
personas.struggles: Gets alerts she doesn't understand and doesn't know if she must act.
personas.how_helps: The incident that needs her opens first, says what analysts already did and exactly what she must do, and lets her mark it done or ask an analyst.

tasks.name: The action-needed incident opens first and can be marked done
Marking done updates the badge and the hero
Notifications open a real panel

personas.cares_about: Full coverage, patched systems, fewer false alarms.
personas.time_spent: Tickets, patching, onboarding laptops, chasing devices that fall off monitoring.
personas.struggles: Alert fatigue and blind spots (devices that stopped reporting).
personas.how_helps: Devices tab lists silent devices by business impact with reasons, install commands and the one update to fix first; Incidents shows how much noise analysts filtered; search finds a host across logs.

tasks.name: Find silent devices by impact and the top fix
Filter devices by office
Search a host from the rail and see alert noise
See alerts reviewed vs escalated

personas.cares_about: Handling many clients without a 24/7 SOC of their own.
personas.time_spent: Switching between client consoles, RMM and PSA tickets.
personas.struggles: Tool sprawl; no one watching at night.
personas.how_helps: Client list with computed status, a cross-client incident queue, PSA ticket numbers, and every tab bound to the selected client, with the analyst on duty and the next shift shown.

tasks.name: Switch to Harbor Auto and every tab follows
Harbor incidents, compliance and insurance are Harbor's
Cross-client queue with PSA tickets
Open a queue item lands on that client's incident

personas.cares_about: Margin on security, recurring revenue, keeping clients.
personas.struggles: Big MDR vendors leave thin margins and lock-in contracts.
personas.how_helps: Partner tab shows wholesale, resale capped at the direct price, profit and margin per client, white-label settings with a client preview, and channel protection.

tasks.name: Check margin per client with resale capped at direct price
Change resale price and preview white-label as a client

personas.cares_about: Passing audits and showing evidence quickly.
personas.time_spent: Policies, risk assessments, collecting screenshots for auditors.
personas.struggles: Evidence is scattered; mapping controls by hand.
personas.how_helps: Compliance tab lists every control per framework with the right citations, evidence source and date, BAA status, honest log retention, and an export with history.

tasks.name: HIPAA view shows BAA, 6-year retention gap and all controls
Framework switch swaps controls and citations
Export evidence with history
One training upload fixes compliance and insurance

personas.cares_about: Insurance premiums, predictable cost, avoiding a breach bill.
personas.struggles: Cyber-insurance questionnaires ask for proof (MFA, EDR, backups) nobody can produce quickly.
personas.how_helps: Insurance tab shows all 10 questions with dated evidence, MFA gaps as warnings, carrier, policy, premium and broker, and a Plan & billing tab with the flat price.

tasks.name: All questions shown, MFA gap is a warning
See plan and invoices

personas.role: MSP account manager / vCIO running client business reviews
personas.cares_about: Renewals, upsells and showing each client the value of the security line item.
personas.time_spent: Quarterly business reviews, proposals, client calls.
personas.struggles: Turning technical data into a client-ready story; assembling QBR decks by hand from several tools.
personas.how_helps: One-click branded QBR per client with threats stopped, coverage, compliance score and open recommendations.

tasks.name: Generate a white-labelled QBR for Ridgeline

personas.role: Practice / branch operations manager responsible for staff onboarding and offboarding
personas.cares_about: Staff leaving do not keep access; new staff are working on day one.
personas.time_spent: HR paperwork, scheduling, onboarding/offboarding staff accounts with IT.
personas.struggles: Forgotten accounts of ex-employees; no visibility of who still has access.
personas.how_helps: Accounts tab lists unused and no-MFA accounts with a one-click disable request that feeds the to-do list and compliance status.

tasks.name: Find accounts unused 30+ days and request disable

personas.role: HIPAA auditor or CMMC third-party assessor (C3PAO) with read-only access
personas.cares_about: Verifiable, timestamped evidence mapped to controls, without chasing the client.
personas.struggles: Screenshots without provenance; evidence arriving late and incomplete.
personas.how_helps: Time-limited read-only link scoped to one client, control-by-control evidence with collection timestamps, and an export log.

tasks.name: Open a CMMC control and download its evidence

personas.cares_about: Accurate answers on MFA, EDR, backups and incident history to place and price cover.
personas.time_spent: Collecting questionnaires and chasing clients before renewal dates.
personas.struggles: Self-attested answers they cannot verify; late submissions.
personas.how_helps: Broker-shared read-only pack with live, dated evidence and a signed provider attestation.

tasks.name: Check MFA/EDR/backup answers with dates and get the attestation

personas.role: Outside counsel or privacy officer handling breach notification
personas.cares_about: Knowing quickly whether an incident is a reportable breach (HIPAA 60-day, state laws, FTC Safeguards 30-day notice for 500+ consumers).
personas.time_spent: Contracts, privacy notices, incident response calls.
personas.struggles: Unclear facts on what data was accessed and when; deadlines start before they are told.
personas.how_helps: Each incident shows whether regulated data was touched, a timeline and the notification clock status.

tasks.name: Open an incident and see data accessed, timeline and notice clock

personas.role: Front-desk or shop-floor employee who reports suspicious email
personas.cares_about: Not getting blamed; knowing quickly whether an email is safe.
personas.struggles: Does not know whom to tell; fears clicking something bad.
personas.how_helps: A 'Report suspicious email' page that works on a phone, with a fast plain-English verdict and next steps, and no access to company security data.

tasks.name: Report a suspicious email after clicking and see the verdict
